info.title: DoodhDesk REST API Specification
info.description:
Complete enterprise REST API for **DoodhDesk** — Modern Multi-Tenant Milk & Daily Essentials Delivery ERP.

### Highlights:
- **Dual Authentication**: Bearer Token via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or Cookie-based Session auth.
- **Multi-Tenancy**: Data isolation guaranteed across dairy tenants with strict tenant boundary enforcement.
- **Quota Enforced**: Transparent SaaS capacity checks (Free 5 customers, elastic upgrades).
- **Anti-Dispute Run-Sheets**: Real-time delivery tracking, vacation pause adjustments, and batch invoicing.
- **Super Admin Governance**: Full platform metrics, tenant lifecycle, and quota overrides.

### Base URLs:
- Gateway: `http://localhost/doodhdesk/index.php/api`
- Direct: `http://localhost/doodhdesk/api`
